data.ruling:
Both refutations stand.

1) Datasheet, input withstand. The owner marked V179 "for research" (Research.md, Raised by P1, owner 2026-09-28). The value P2 found is the requirement: 85 V between the two sense leads in either polarity, and 85 V from either lead to ground, without damage. P2's found value is in FU-B1/004-P2-R8.json and T3/004-P2-R8.json. It rests on F15 (67.2 V pack) and on the R3 clamp, which holds the pack node under 85 V. Re-reading SLYS025B section 5.1 gives an absolute maximum for (VIN+) - (VIN-) of -40 V to +40 V, and 5 mA into any pin. Section 7.1.4 names the fault that V179 covers: a load-side short to ground "can result in full power-supply voltage across the shunt". Even the 67.2 V pack alone exceeds the 40 V differential rating by 27.2 V; at 85 V the excess is 45 V. The common-mode rating (-0.3 V to 85 V) and VBUS (-0.3 V to 85 V) pass. The differential rating fails. Section 7.1.4 also says "Do not use values greater than 100 ohm for RFILTER". A series resistor that holds 5 mA at 85 V would be 17 kohm, so the filter resistor cannot supply the current limit. Meeting V179 needs protection parts in front of IN+ and IN-, and no R8 part provides it.

2) Stock, rule 4. The need is 5 boards (S7) x 2 INA238 (F1) = 10, and the S4 gate is 50. JLCPCB's exact match for C2868250 (INA238AIDGSR, Texas Instruments, VSSOP-10) reads stockCount 0 and canPresaleNumber -99. A negative presale count fails rule 4 whatever the stock says. Digi-Key stock is 0 in every packaging (cached reading). The part is not in the personal library (inventory-2026-09-25.csv has no INA23x row), so rule 6 does not apply.

The lifecycle figures agree with the verifier and pass: Digi-Key Active, 16-week lead time, JLCPCB "expand", Texas Instruments on the S1 allowlist. No part-level cause (lifecycle, end-of-life notice, allowlist, LCSC identity) fails.

Scope is function. The withstand failure is against this function's own V179 requirement. The stock failure is against the rule-4 need that this function's placement contributes to.
data.evidence:
SLYS025B (header "SLYS025B - JANUARY 2021 - REVISED MAY 2025"), section 5.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings:
- Differential (VIN+) - (VIN-): MIN -40 V, MAX 40 V.
- Common-mode: -0.3 V to 85 V.
- VVBUS: -0.3 V to 85 V.
- IIN (input current into any pin): 5 mA.

SLYS025B section 7.1.4:
- "The device inputs are specified to tolerate ±40 V differential across the IN+ and IN– pins. A large differential scenario can be a short to ground on the load side of the shunt. This type of event can result in full power-supply voltage across the shunt."
- "Do not use values greater than 100Ω for RFILTER."

Requirement: V179 answer "for research (owner, 2026-09-28)", checkout e13f5f60d2e5 hardware/docs/Research.md:739. P2's found value is "85 V from either lead to the board's ground and 85 V between the two leads in either polarity, without damage" (FU-B1/004-P2-R8.json). F15 is 67.2 V (Research.md:543), which alone is more than 40 V.
